titleZh: 熱情 ↔ 冷漠｜火山對冰箱
hook: 左邊火山噴火（ardent/ardor），右邊冰箱貼自己（apathetic/callous）——溫度計當場罷工。
script: ardent／ardor／fervid／zealous 火山隊。apathetic／callous／stolid／phlegmatic 冰箱隊。考場口令：火山寫熱情句，冰箱寫「無所謂」。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by intense emotion; characterized by strong enthusiasm
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 火山心: ardent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「火山心」出場：ardent 一上場梗就黏住——熱心的。

related.synonyms: fervent, fervid, fiery, impassioned, perfervid, torrid

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause); intense feeling of love
